name: Manasses
description: Named in Tobit's deathbed words as one who gave alms and so escaped the snares of death that were set for him, contrasted with Aman who perished; the text gives no further identifying detail, and this is not linked to any other person named Manasseh

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
